functions.name: str_replace_based_edit_tool
functions.description: View, create and edit text files. Commands: view (a file or a directory listing; view_range limits it to a line range), create (a new file with file_text), str_replace (replace old_str, which must match exactly once, with new_str), insert (insert_text after line insert_line; 0 is the start of the file). Views of a file are truncated to 10000 characters.

path.description: The file or directory the command applies to.

view_range.description: view only: [start_line, end_line], 1-indexed; an end line of -1 reads to the end of the file.

old_str.description: str_replace only: the text to replace, matched exactly, including whitespace.

new_str.description: str_replace only: the text to put in its place.

file_text.description: create only: the content of the new file.

insert_line.description: insert only: the line after which to insert; 0 inserts at the start of the file.

insert_text.description: insert only: the text to insert.
